events.eventDescription: Calling "mkdir(get_telemetry_dir(), 493U)" without checking return value. This library function may fail and return an error code.

issueOccurrences.localEffect: The function returns a value that indicates an error condition. If this is not checked, the error condition may not be handled correctly.
issueOccurrences.longDescription: Value returned from a library function is not checked for errors before being used. This value may indicate an error condition.
